name: vision_medical3d_bad
title: The same MONAI segmentation run with nine planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 2: the dirty twin of vision_medical3d. Eight of its nine defects are invisible because MONAI wraps torch's DataLoader and passes the model into an inference helper (VIS2-10)

expected.why: every InstanceNorm3d and Dropout in the UNet behaves as it does in training while the mean Dice that selects the checkpoint is measured
expected.gap: the model is not *called* in the eval loop - it is handed to sliding_window_inference as an argument, which is how every MONAI, nnU-Net and medical-imaging validation pass is written. MLV301's eval-region test requires a model forward, so it sees no eval region and says nothing. Repro in the round-2 report (VIS2-10).

expected.why: sliding_window_inference over a 512x512x200 volume at overlap 0.5 builds an autograd graph for hundreds of patches, which is an immediate out-of-memory

expected.defect: the training loader does not shuffle
expected.why: BTCV volumes are listed patient by patient and CacheDataset preserves that order, so every batch is one abdomen and the batch-norm statistics track the patient rather than the dataset
expected.gap: monai.data.DataLoader subclasses torch.utils.data.DataLoader but resolves to `monai`, which has no knowledge table, so MLV110/111/112 never see a loader. The same is true of torch_geometric.loader.DataLoader and of every mmcv-style runner. Repro in the round-2 report (VIS2-10).

expected.defect: scaler.step() is never followed by scaler.update()
expected.why: the loss scale never adapts, so the first overflow freezes the run at a scale it can never recover from
expected.gap: the scaler arrives as a parameter of train_one_epoch, and MLV208 does not cross that boundary in either dataflow mode - the identical defect fires when the scaler is local. Repro in the round-2 report (VIS2-07).

expected.defect: the epoch loss keeps the live tensor
expected.why: a 3-D UNet graph over 96^3 patches is retained for the whole epoch
expected.gap: DiceCELoss resolves to monai, so the value carries no LOSS tag. MLView does declare this one: the untagged_dataflow diagnostic names MLV201/202/203/205 at train.py:74.

expected.defect: the whole module is pickled rather than its state_dict
expected.why: the checkpoint carries monai's class path and breaks across MONAI versions
expected.gap: MLV803 requires the saved value to carry the MODEL tag, and build_model() returns a monai.networks.nets.UNet, which does not.

expected.defect: both set_determinism(seed=...) and torch.manual_seed(seed) are gone
expected.why: RandCropByPosNegLabeld draws a different set of patches every run, so two runs of the same configuration produce different Dice scores

expected.defect: the validation pipeline is a copy of the training one, random stages included
expected.why: the reported Dice is measured on flipped, rotated, intensity-shifted patches cropped with a 1:1 positive/negative bias the real volumes do not have - it is an optimistic number for a quantity that is not the clinical one
expected.gap: MONAI's keyed transforms are not in any knowledge table, so the Compose has no AUGMENT element for MLV114 to find.

expected.defect: the head emits one channel while the loss one-hots the target to 14 classes and applies a softmax over that single channel
expected.why: softmax over one channel is identically 1, so the Dice term has no gradient at all and the shape mismatch against the one-hot target either raises or broadcasts into nonsense
expected.gap: no rule cross-checks a framework loss's own normalisation keyword against the head width. MLV401 is the direct analogue for torch and MLV709 for Keras; MONAI has neither.

forbidden.why: there is no sklearn transformer in this project
the validation loader is still built with shuffle=False
the loaders are built inside build_loaders(), reached only from main() under the __main__ guard
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is still the first statement of the training step
the backward still precedes the step
there is no no_grad region left, so nothing can be inside one
CosineAnnealingLR is an epoch schedule and scheduler.step() still runs in the epoch loop
the prediction is still discretised by AsDiscrete(argmax=True) before the metric
there is no sigmoid and no BCE loss in this project
the model is moved with .to(device) and both keys of every batch are moved inside both loops
the split is read from dataset.json; nothing is split at run time
there is no nn.Module subclass in this workspace

gaps.what: a framework DataLoader subclass (monai.data.DataLoader, torch_geometric.loader.DataLoader, mmcv runners) is not recognised as a DataLoader, so the whole MLV1xx loader family and the LOADER tag every MLV2xx rule keys on are unavailable
gaps.evidence: train.py:47 shuffle=False draws nothing; the identical torch.utils.data.DataLoader fires MLV110

gaps.what: an inference helper that takes the model as an argument (sliding_window_inference, mmdet's inference_detector, a Trainer.predict) is not a model forward, so MLV301/MLV302 see no eval region at all - and no diagnostic says the evaluation was not judged
gaps.evidence: train.py:94 against the clean twin's identical call under model.eval() + @torch.no_grad()
